# UnlimitedPDF

> UnlimitedPDF is a C# PDF library for .NET. It creates PDF documents with text, tables, and JPEG and PNG images, merges and splits existing PDFs, and converts HTML with CSS to PDF, saved to a file or a stream. It is pure managed .NET with no native code and no third-party package dependencies, and it runs in Blazor WebAssembly. This site is its interactive playground: every demo builds its PDF in the browser and shows the C# code that builds it.

Key facts:

- Install: `dotnet add package UnlimitedPDF`, or `<PackageReference Include="UnlimitedPDF" Version="1.0.0" />`.
- Target frameworks: `net6.0`, `net8.0`, `net9.0`, `net10.0`, and `net11.0`, including Blazor WebAssembly (`browser`).
- License: Apache-2.0, so commercial use is allowed.
- Every public type is in the `UnlimitedPDF` namespace, so `using UnlimitedPDF;` is the only `using` needed.
- Main types: `PdfDocument` (pages, header, footer, body flow, save), `PdfPage` (text, rectangles, images, tables), `PdfTable`, `PdfImage`, `PdfColor`, `PdfFile` (load an existing PDF), `PdfHtml`, and `PdfOperations` (`Merge`, `Split`, `ConvertHtml`).
- Positions and sizes are in PDF points (1/72 inch); `PdfUnits` converts from millimeters, centimeters, inches, and pixels.
- Not supported yet: custom fonts (text uses the PDF standard fonts, and characters outside Western European are written as `?`), encryption, digital signatures, and PDF/A.

Quick start:

```cs
using UnlimitedPDF;

var pdfDocument = new PdfDocument();
var page = pdfDocument.AddPage();
page.AddText("UnlimitedPDF library - Sample PDF", 50, 750, 24);
page.AddText("This is the first line on the first page.", 50, 730, 12);
pdfDocument.Save("sample.pdf");
```

## Docs

- [README on GitHub](https://github.com/unlimited-docs/UnlimitedPDF#readme): install, sample code, tables across pages, headers and footers, images, merge, split, HTML to PDF, upgrading to 1.0.0, and the change list.
- [NuGet package](https://www.nuget.org/packages/UnlimitedPDF): package versions and target frameworks.
- [FAQ](faq): platforms, text and fonts, tables and layout, images, merge and split, HTML to PDF, and license.

## Create PDFs

- [Add text and pages to a PDF in C#](playground/create/text-and-pages): Choose a page size, place text at any position and size, and add pages.
- [Create PDF tables in C#](playground/create/tables): Column widths, colors, borders, padding, alignment, and row height rules.
- [Add JPEG and PNG images to a PDF in C#](playground/create/images): Place JPEG and PNG images with fit modes, sizes, and inside table cells. Try your own image.
- [PDF headers, footers, and page numbers in C#](playground/create/headers-and-footers): A report with a header and footer on every page, page numbers, first and last page settings, and content that flows onto new pages.

## Merge PDFs

- [Merge PDF files in C#](playground/merge/join-files): Join whole PDFs in one call, in the order you choose.
- [Merge a cover page and PDF page ranges in C#](playground/merge/cover-and-ranges): Put a built cover page in front of chosen page ranges from each file.
- [Extract and reorder PDF pages in C#](playground/merge/pick-pages): Take the pages you want from a PDF, in the order you want, such as 3, 1-2.
- [Merged PDF bookmarks and page numbers in C#](playground/merge/bookmarks-and-numbers): Name each file's bookmark; the contents and closing pages show page numbers that count every merged page.
- [Month-end PDF pack: generate and merge in C#](playground/merge/month-end-pack): An invoice, a receipt, and an account statement, generated and merged behind a cover page.
- [Employee PDF pack: generate and merge in C#](playground/merge/employee-pack): A payslip and a certificate, generated and merged behind a cover page.
- [Patient PDF pack: generate and merge in C#](playground/merge/patient-pack): A medical report and a receipt, generated and merged behind a cover page.

## Split PDFs

- [Split a PDF every N pages in C#](playground/split/every-n-pages): Split a PDF into parts of the same number of pages, such as one file per page or every 10 pages.
- [Split a PDF by page ranges in C#](playground/split/page-ranges): Make one PDF per page range you choose, such as 1-2, 3, 2-4. Ranges may overlap and leave pages out.

## HTML to PDF

- [Convert HTML to PDF in C#](playground/html/html-to-pdf): Pick a template or paste your own HTML, then convert it with the built-in renderer: no browser engine, no upload.
- [Common HTML to PDF problems in C#](playground/html/common-problems): Rows cut at page breaks, headers that don't repeat, long URLs, nested tables and lists, images, links, and print styles: open a problem, see the PDF, and edit the HTML.

## Complete business documents

- [Create a PDF invoice in C#](playground/documents/invoice): A tax invoice with a logo, product photos in the line items, and computed totals.
- [Create a PDF quotation in C#](playground/documents/quotation): A services quotation with its own first-page header, a last-page footer, and terms kept with the signature.
- [Create a PDF purchase order in C#](playground/documents/purchase-order): A purchase order whose item table runs across pages, with the totals kept together at the end.
- [Create a PDF delivery note in C#](playground/documents/delivery-note): A delivery note that lists ordered and shipped quantities and keeps the signature block together.
- [Create a PDF bank statement in C#](playground/documents/account-statement): A bank statement with a first-page summary, a running balance, and the header row on every page.
- [Create a PDF payslip in C#](playground/documents/payslip): A one-page payslip with earnings, deductions, and net pay, held to one page by a page limit.
- [Create a PDF medical report in C#](playground/documents/medical-report): A laboratory report with patient details, results, reference ranges, and flags.
- [Create a PDF receipt in C#](playground/documents/receipt): A compact A6 store receipt with items, tax, and payment details.
- [Create a PDF certificate in C#](playground/documents/certificate): A certificate of achievement with a seal and a signature image.
- [Create a PDF employee directory in C#](playground/documents/employee-directory): A long table that continues across pages, repeats its header row, and numbers every page.
